hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: Market-cap-tiered fee hook for ETH-paired pools that charges fees on buys and sells, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and the token creator address. Fees range from 1% (low market cap) to 0.1% (high market cap), applied via BeforeSwapDelta on exact-input buys and AfterSwapDelta on exact-output buys and exact-input sells. Exact-output sells are blocked.
